scenario: one simulated robot arm, one red cube, one tray-A target; no real hardware
simulator_selection: MuJoCo (installation and capability probe required before M1)

comparison.B1: same LLM and skill catalog without LFL goal/recovery management
comparison.B2: same LLM, skill catalog, seeds and limits with LFL goal/evidence/recovery management

primary_endpoint: independent Oracle end-to-end placement success; executor claims do not count
secondary_endpoints: provider tokens and USD per verified task

stop_rules: any real device or production robot contact
any Oracle canary or privileged truth in model-visible data
any unauthorized action or unknown-action duplicate dispatch
any physical simulator motion after unconfirmed stop
any change of frozen model/skills/budget/seeds without new experiment ID

change_policy: Any post-freeze protocol change creates a new experiment_id; never rewrite prior trial results
